thread:
nora: quick heads-up: scheduling a conservative v2 rollout in the 02:00 UTC quiet window tomorrow. keeping blast radius tiny — aim is to validate header negotiation and streaming backpressure. posting the short checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-2026-04-05-01, initial_canary=2%, window=02:00-03:00 UTC. will post status events to this thread. :small_blue_diamond:

kevin: please include a release-notes blurb that explains the `x-redwood-version` header and how older SDKs are routed to v1 by default. also include customer pin instructions.

jia: on it — drafting the blurb + migration FAQ. will add console path: Console -> Routing -> Pin to v1.

sam: rollback triggers proposal: error_rate >= 1% for 5m OR 95p latency > 700ms for 5m -> auto-pin. add streaming drop >0.3% over 5m -> ops-eyes. Also flag token_cost_delta > +25% sustained 10m.

nora: agree. probe plan: `v2-canary-probe` (http + stream probe), config: `interval=30s, fail_threshold=3, auth_grace=90s`. failing probe -> escalate; 4 fails -> auto-pin.

devops-bot: prewarm policy applied: warmup=6m for canary pool, min_instances=2. hooks wired to #eng-oncall. queue_length alert >120 for 2m.

nora: internal pinlist for initial wave: ["int-smoke","int-load"]. excluding paid tenants this stage.

nora: deploy command (ops-approved):
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-04-05-01 \
  --route /api/v2 \
  --canary 2 \
  --probe v2-canary-probe \
  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: canary starting now, diverting 2% of eligible traffic to v2. snapshots posted to console every 2m.

kevin: watches: canary_error_rate, canary_95p_latency, stream_frame_drop, kv_cache_hit, token_cost_delta. set ops-eyes alert at error_rate >0.4% for 2m; auto-pin at >1% for 5m.

sam: confirm rollback runbook: 1) deploy-bot pins route to v1; 2) scale down v2 pool; 3) run triage; 4) reopen after fix. owners: nora (release lead), kevin (sre), sam (on-call).

jia: release note snippet staged. small migration FAQ added with sample `curl -H \"x-redwood-version: v2\"`. will link when PR merges.

devops-bot: first snapshot uploaded: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/rb-2026-04-05-01/snapshots/1

nora: 20m check: 95p latency 390ms, error_rate 0.06%, stream_frame_drop 0.01%, token_cost_delta +3%. holding for 1h stable before expanding.

kevin: no anomalies on infra side. ready to expand to 10% internal after 1h if metrics stay stable.

sam: note: watch edge auth TTLs — saw 40s jitter in staging earlier that caused transient 401s. bumping auth_grace to 120s.

nora: auth_grace bumped. if all green after the hour we'll widen in next quiet window. thanks all. :thumbsup:
